consulted.title: Python 3.10 runtime now available in AWS Lambda | AWS Compute Blog
consulted.content:
### AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK)

In the AWS CDK, set the runtime attribute to `Runtime.PYTHON_3_10` to use this version. In Python: [...] To update an existing Lambda function to Python 3.10, navigate to the function in the Lambda console, then choose Edit in the Runtime settings panel. The new version of Python is available in the Runtime dropdown:

Edit runtime settings

Edit runtime settings

### AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM)

In AWS SAM, set the Runtime attribute to `python3.10` to use this version. [...] To use the Python 3.10 runtime to develop your Lambda functions, specify a runtime parameter value Python 3.10 when creating or updating a function. Python 3.10 version is now available in the Runtime dropdown in the Create function page.

Lambda create function page

Lambda create function page
